newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes mostly up on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes mostly up on mill buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mostly higher on mill buying, traders said.
"There was another round of mill buying," a trader said. "The back months gained on the front months on a correction from last week."

U.S. wheat futures weakened early on a sharp drop in CBOT soybeans but the bean market again showed its buoyancy by trading higher within 15 minutes of the lower close. CBOT soybean futures closed lower but well off the session lows.
MGE spring wheat futures closed three cents per bushel lower to two cents higher, with March down three at $4.25 a bushel. May was up 1/4 at $4.00-1/2.
Barley futures closed unchanged to three cents per cwt lower with March unchanged at $6.75 per cwt and May down three cents at $6.77.
